problem:
Evaluate the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}18x\,\text{d}V
$$

where $R$ is the type II region given by 

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le y\le 2,\,0\le z\le 1,\,0\le x\le yz}.
$$
worked_solution:
Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}18x\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{yz}18x\,dx\,dz\,dy.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{yz}18x\,dx\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{yz}18x\,dx]dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}[9{x}^{2}]_{x=0}^{x=yz}dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}9(yz)^{2}\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}9{y}^{2}{z}^{2}\,dz\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z,$ treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}9{y}^{2}{z}^{2}\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{1}9{y}^{2}{z}^{2}\,dz]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[3{y}^{2}{z}^{3}]_{z=0}^{z=1}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}3{y}^{2}\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}3{y}^{2}\,dy & =[{y}^{3}]_{y=0}^{y=2} \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$
